name: RAMen
author: boundsj
description: RAM gauge, guarded app termination, memory history, opt-in sustained incident alerts, an on-demand storage explorer and an Apps page with CPU/RAM rails and per-app GPU memory where the kernel reports it.

barWidget.description: Memory gauge; click for the Memory, History, Storage and Apps pages

schema.label: Label
schema.description: Text next to the gauge: percent used, GB used, GB available, or gauge only.

schema.label: Measurement animations
schema.description: Turn off RAMen gauge and Memory transitions. A shell reduced-motion preference also disables them. History never animates measurements.

schema.label: Collect memory history
schema.description: Collect samples and sustained incidents. Required for alerts. Off keeps live status and preserves the saved file.

schema.label: Save history across restarts
schema.description: Off uses session-only history without loading or saving the history file. Clear history explicitly erases saved history.

schema.label: Incident notifications
schema.description: Requires history collection. Turning alerts off keeps incidents and bar colors.

schema.label: Yellow at memory pressure %
schema.description: PSI some avg10: share of time tasks stalled on memory.

schema.label: Apps page sort
schema.description: How the Apps page ranks apps when it opens. GPU memory needs a GPU that reports dedicated memory per client (DRM fdinfo); until it does, the page shows Memory with a note.

schema.label: Apps GPU metrics
schema.description: auto reads per-app GPU memory and engine use from the kernel's DRM fdinfo only while the Apps page is visible, at most every 5 s, without waking a sleeping GPU. off does no GPU work. Never changes the memory bar.
